Title: Last Player Standing and self-oust question

Messages.Author: The Name Forgotten
Messages.Body:
I just want some clarification on this point.

If it is only you and your prey left in the game - both on 1 pool -
and you call a Kine Resources Contested that ousts both you and your
prey. Then both of you will receive a VP (for the simultaneous
ousting), and no-one receives the last player standing VP, correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
